g.title: j660310432
g.text: Broadsword: Whoever else is on the board, I think we’ve made this year, this place, this time ours. Let’s never let go. Let’s protect the people here and each other.

g.text: xX GLIMMER Xx: yeah, let’s make things happen! things to look forward to, memories. more. save others, not just ourselves.
